__comment: The dependency check's memory (.claude/skills/dependency-check/SKILL.md). One entry per security advisory the monthly run has triaged, keyed by its GHSA id: the package and package directory (apps/guide, workers, scripts), the installed version it was triaged at, the verdict (`applies`, `does-not-apply`, or `unclear`), the evidence (which function or path the advisory is about, and where the code does or does not reach it), and the date. A `does-not-apply` verdict is re-examined when the package, its installed version, or the code that calls it changes; an `applies` or `unclear` verdict is re-examined every run until a fix lands. Only the dependency check writes this file, in its own PR.

GHSA-2gcr-mfcq-wcc3.evidence: app.mount() prefix stripping and parseBody() dot-notation nesting. workers/src imports only 'hono', 'hono/cors' and 'hono/factory' (grep of workers/src), and calls neither app.mount() nor parseBody(); JWTs go through @tsndr/cloudflare-worker-jwt, not hono/jwt. GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj.evidence: libvips and libheif decoder vulnerabilities, triggered by decoding untrusted images. Nothing ships sharp to a reader: it runs at build time on the owner's machine or in Actions. But some inputs come from outside the repo: scripts/fetch-guide-photos.mjs decodes Wikimedia Commons thumbnails, apps/guide/scripts/gen-map-tiles.ts decodes terrarium PNG tiles from s3.amazonaws.com/elevation-tiles-prod, and scripts/ingest-photos.mjs (also run by .github/workflows/photo-import.yml on files uploaded through the Worker's /photos page) calls metadata() on HEIC files, which reaches libheif. Those sources are trusted publishers or the owner's own uploads (bearer-gated by PHOTO_UPLOAD_TOKEN), so exploitation needs a compromised upstream; treated as applies. In workers/ sharp is an optional dependency of miniflare (wrangler dev), never called.
GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj.fix: Fixed in sharp 0.35.4+, which is a semver-major for a 0.x package: held back, migration at the top of the PR body. Re-examine every run until the 0.35 move lands.
